descriptor.directory_note: The seek DIRECTORY record adds 27,390 B (12 B framing + 27,378 B payload) and is located at fixed offset 64. It carries 1,608 locators (the DIRECTORY itself, UNIVERSE, FORMAT, 800 MODEL, 800 ENTROPY_CHANNEL, 1 OBJECT, GRAPH, OBSERVATION_INDEX, INTEGRITY, TRAILER), a class index, and 800 channel decoded lengths; it is well under the 1 MiB max_directory_bytes bound. Non-seekable lanes re-base +18 B versus Phase 7 only because the UNIVERSE string gained the +seek-directory-v1 suffix; the serialized record sequence for seek_directory == false is otherwise unchanged.

corpus_limitation: Streams are level-0 (stored) zlib, so the corpus is the weak-producer regime where exact replay is trivially available and corrections are tiny (28 B/stream, deduplicated to one 28 B object). It is NOT a survey of strong real-world DEFLATE; it is a large multi-object random-access stress corpus. Distinctness of per-stream plaintext (not repeated-bytes) is what makes the query court meaningful.
